title: THE DISTRIBUTION OF SULFER COMPOUND ON PALLADIUM BLACK AND ITS CATALYTIC POISONING EFFECT
abstract: Abstract                The difference of the selectivity between poisoned by ethylsulfide and non-poisoned Pd-black was observed in the catalytic hydrogenation of isoprene. To obtain the information of the poisoning state, electron microprobe X-ray analysis method was applied. According to the S-Kα radiation profile, ethylsulfide was distributed uniformly on the surface.
